cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 14 days (336 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description: Experience the ultimate in luxury and sophistication aboard the Marquis 70, a stunning motor yacht designed for comfort, style, and unforgettable moments on the water. With its sleek lines, spacious interiors, and top-tier amenities, this yacht offers a premium cruising experience for private gatherings, corporate events, or celebratory occasions.
what_to_bring: Photo ID and credit card used for payment required for check in.
disclaimers: Equivalent sailing experience required. A sailing resume will need to be completed at least 48 hours prior to rental for new customers.
